name: Computational Phase Modulation (CGH Generation)
definition: Uses a Liquid Crystal SLM (LCSLM) to modulate the phase of a reflected laser beam. The SLM acts as an optical phased array where molecule directions are controlled by electrodes (pixels) to modulate phase.
summary: Computational Phase Modulation generates holograms by iteratively optimizing phase-only spatial light modulators to match target intensities, distinguishing itself by discarding amplitude information for volumetric display.
